V-öltés (03 §4.2 F)

Abbreviations (US terms)
ch – chain
ch-sp – chain space
dc – double crochet
sk – skip
st(s) – stitch(es)
V-st – V-stitch

Stitch key (US terms)
chain (ch)
double crochet (dc)
V-stitch (V-st): (dc, ch 1, dc) in same st
chain space (ch-sp)

V-öltés
Foundation: ch 17.
Row 1: Starting in 4th ch from hook, dc, sk 1 ch, V-st, [sk 2 ch, V-st] 3 times, sk 1 ch, dc (10 sts). Turn.
Row 2: ch 3 (does not count as a st), dc, [V-st in next ch-sp] 4 times, sk 1 st, dc (10 sts). Fasten off.
